description: This is a PHP source file defining an 'Notification' controller class within the OpenCart admin module. It manages notification listing, viewing, editing, and deletion functionalities in the admin interface.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Controller class for managing notifications in the admin panel, including listing, viewing details, and deleting notifications.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to render the notification list page, setting up breadcrumbs, headers, and views.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of notifications in response to an AJAX request, with pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns a paginated list of notifications as an HTML view.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific notification, including title and text, and allows marking it as read.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected notifications via AJAX and returns success/error status in JSON.
